name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Human-governed project memory that preserves exact evidence, resumes unfinished work, and keeps acceptance under the user's control.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence Lane 2.1.0 - 62 native actions (21 read / 41 write) - 15 governed skills.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane is human-governed project memory for Codex. It preserves exact source, evidence, Delta, task, candidate, and accepted-version identity across long-running work. Evidence Lane 2.1.0 is the mutable stable Codex successor release; the disabled PV11 fallback remains the immutable accepted 2.0.0 package. This package carries fifteen governed skills and one package-local native MCP server named evidence-lane with sixty-two canonical actions: twenty-one read-only and forty-one write-capable. It supports Source Intake, Build, Refresh, pointer-only Rollback, exact-APPROVE Fuse, State Travel, Mode, local durable storage, plugin administration, panels, search, diff, and governed Git evidence while keeping candidate acceptance human-controlled. Historical Git, package, and PV receipts remain immutable archive evidence. Google Drive is a separately named and authorized connector, never the Evidence Lane MCP, lifecycle proof, namespace owner, or durable local project authority. Codex lifecycle evidence must come from the package-local native server, never codex_apps, plugin-runtime, generated namespaces, direct-stdio fallback, or an external connector. Natural HIL intent never promotes a candidate, and only exact case-sensitive APPROVE may authorize Fuse on a genuinely write-capable governed host.
defaultPrompt: Boot Evidence Lane, verify ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls with host availability.
Show the accepted PV, Entry/Exit Slips, source lanes, and persistent plan without mutation.
Explain the current six-way HIL and exact next decision in clear business language.
